criteria.name: Datasets are versioned
criteria.evidence: content addressing holds in both directions: identical content fingerprints to sha256:bdb48d6a1 across two constructions, altered content to sha256:5520c315e, and the registry returns each dataset under its own fingerprint (2 registered)

criteria.name: Backtests are deterministic
criteria.evidence: two isolated interpreters produced identical results (sha256:27d1cf298) and identical artifact digests (sha256:edc2d19d8) for the same dataset, strategy and seed

criteria.name: Artifacts are reproducible
criteria.evidence: identical inputs yield digest sha256:475d586e8 across two builds, and altering the evaluation report changes it to sha256:b335b49e9, so the digest tracks content rather than being constant
